stages.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: isolated photographic food illustration for the front label of a restrained Russian chicken meatball package, to be composited at a small scale into an existing cream-paper design.
Primary request: produce one exceptionally natural, appetizing, professional studio food photograph of a small asymmetrical pair of cooked chicken meatballs: exactly ONE whole round meatball at back-left and exactly ONE half meatball at front-right. Both come from the same small 4 cm diameter meatball. The full silhouette of the rear whole ball must remain visible; the half sits slightly in front, cut face toward the camera at a subtle angle. Make the group balanced, compact, and unpretentious.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background; complete objects with generous empty transparent margin. No background texture, no horizon, no plate or props. Only a very soft tiny contact shadow directly below the food, or no shadow.
Style/medium: highly realistic carefully styled commercial food photography, faithful to actual cooked finely minced chicken meatballs, not an illustration or a render. A modest front three-quarter tabletop view, camera slightly above the pair. Crisp real detail, normal lens perspective, restrained local contrast, no oversharpening.
Food surface: natural thin golden-brown pan-browned crust with gentle irregular browning, a soft matte fine-grained surface with mild natural moisture. It is a tender minced-meat meatball, not breaded, not crunchy, not oily or shiny. A very few tiny integrated green pinpoints are acceptable but optional.
Cut interior: the exposed cross-section of the half is the key quality feature. It must be a SINGLE COMPACT COHESIVE mass of finely ground cooked chicken, pale creamy beige, with microscopic irregular pores and very fine granular crumbs. Its natural texture resembles a tender finely minced chicken patty or a well-made chicken quenelle. Uniformly cooked, succulent but matte. Smoothly cut with a real kitchen knife, no large cavities. The meat is finely minced, not shredded. No visible long meat fibers, no parallel structures, no strips, no rodlike pieces, no rice grains, no stringy strands, no noodles, no cheese, no layered filling. Small irregular flecks under one millimeter only.
Lighting/mood: broad soft neutral studio light from upper-left, gentle pale highlights and soft natural shading. Sophisticated photographic realism and natural appetizing texture, quiet warm neutral palette, not dramatic orange, not saturated yellow.
Constraints: exactly one whole ball plus one half. No garnish, herbs outside the food, sauce, parsley leaves, vegetables, seeds, utensils, hands, dishes, floating particles, text, logo, packaging, labels or watermark. No black burnt patches, no bread crumb coating, no plastic gloss. Everything fully contained in the frame with clean natural soft edges, genuine transparent background.

stages.purpose: Unique chicken-with-spoon, original Strips style reference
stages.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve edit.
Edit target: the ORIGINAL Stripsy package photograph in the single supplied reference. Find the small printed hen pulling the cart near the lower centre of the sleeve. Extract and redraw THAT EXACT SAME HEN CHARACTER in THAT EXACT SAME ILLUSTRATOR'S STYLE, changing only its pose and prop. Output just the complete isolated character on transparent background, without any label, package, cart, harness, photo or words.

Character identity is locked to the reference hen: small sharply shaped head, small narrow mischievous golden eye, curved pointed beak, modest red comb and hanging red wattle, thick tilted golden-ochre body, irregular sharp orange-brown wing and tail feathers, skinny dark brown legs and clawed toes. Preserve the reference's specific cheek/eye/beak shapes and the same lively slightly grumpy/earnest comic expression. Match the EXACT degree of simple hand-drawn printed graphic detail and the same ochre/brown colour patches. This is the old illustrator's concise caricature on this actual food label, with a little irregular warm dark ink and a matte slightly softened printed appearance.

NEW UNIQUE POSE: this SAME hen stands firmly in three-quarter view, with its substantial body tilted a little forward. One wing bends naturally forward, gripping a short plain wooden tasting spoon. The spoon's bowl holds exactly ONE small pale golden matte chicken meatball. The hen holds this spoon just below and slightly in front of the beak, eyes looking attentively at the meatball with quiet satisfaction, as if checking its cooking. The other wing rests naturally at the side of the hip. Clearly only two wings, both anatomically clear, no human hands, no extra arms. Two feet completely visible. Tail feathers are a small trailing tuft at the back, unmistakably a tail. Compact interesting silhouette, head and spoon close together. No costume, chef hat, apron, collar, harness, cart or other props. The wooden spoon and one little meatball are the only new objects. The meatball is subtly matte and finely minced, with no rice grains, stripes, seeds or green garnish.

This must look like the same artist drew a new pose of the same existing Stripsy hen for a new pack in the same series. NOT a new generic chicken illustration. Do NOT make it more detailed or more realistic than the original. Do NOT add dense feather hatching, engraving lines, fine realistic scales, natural history rendering, watercolor washes or more intricate shading. Keep the concise cartoon printed shapes and irregular pointed feathers actually visible in the reference. Keep the head small, the eye small and narrow, the face expressive. No huge round baby head, huge eye, chibi, Disney/Pixar, modern vector sticker, thick uniform black border, 3D or polished gradients.

Transparent background; full unclipped silhouette of hen, feet, spoon and meatball with comfortable margins; no ground shadow, halo, scene, text or watermark.

stages.purpose: Assemble the approved label with separately developed food and illustration
stages.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Make a precise, restrained edit of the existing Fibriki package, using the supplied FINISHED artwork rather than inventing another mascot or food texture.

Image 1 = LOCKED package/layout target. Its upper label, text, paper, tub geometry and perspective are approved.
Image 2 = finished high-quality FOOD photograph to insert at lower left. Preserve this exact pair's natural minced-chicken texture and cut surface.
Image 3 = finished original CHICKEN illustration to insert at lower right. Preserve its exact face, pose, wooden spoon, irregular feather shapes, small half-closed eye, ochre/brown ink shapes and hand-drawn printed style. Do not redesign or cartoonize it. The character is now standing and studying a Fibrik on a spoon, not flying and not juggling.
Image 4 = existing Strips package, only to calibrate the modest scale and soft printed appearance, not to copy its cart or pose.

Change the lower printed art on Image 1:
- REMOVE its old diving chef and the big floating ball completely. In their place print Image 3's standing chicken-with-spoon, complete feet and tail, approx x425–700/y318–525 on an800px canvas. Keep it the same modest size/overall footprint as the old right art. The illustration should look printed directly on the same paper, no sticker border, no white outline. Preserve the distinctive narrow eye, pointed beak and irregular brown feather linework. No hat or apron. Replace ONLY the little grainy ball in its spoon with a little cooked chicken ball of the same cohesive fine-mince surface as Image2. No rice/grains/threads.
- REMOVE the old left food pyramid and insert the TWO-piece serving group from Image2: one whole chicken ball behind-left and one half in front-right. Keep the entire group small, approx x125–355/y360–505, beneath the existing brown arc; not oversized food advertising. Use the exact natural fine-minced chicken cross section of Image2: cohesive pale beige, tiny irregular pores, no white strips/fibers/rice/noodles/cheese. Natural thin browned crust, quiet studio lighting, no plastic gloss. No garnish, plate, extra pieces or food props.
- Correct the real RAW/FROZEN meatballs visible inside the clear tub: preserve each ball's shape, pale raw color, arrangement and frost, but give them homogeneous finely MINCED chicken texture. Remove ALL elongated white rice-like rods and stripes. Very fine short irregular minced grain only, no cooked brown crust inside the actual tub.

LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE from Image1: exact NOVOferma logo; elegant brown serif «ФИБРИКИ» with same glyphs, weight and dimensions; tracked «ФРИКАДЕЛЬКИ ИЗ КУРИЦЫ»; tiny two lines «С ПИЩЕВЫМИ» / «ВОЛОКНАМИ»; curved «БЕЛОК + КЛЕТЧАТКА». All baselines, positions, scale, ink colours and spelling must remain identical. Preserve quiet cream paper, sleeve curve and silhouette, brown inner sides, transparent container and complete natural rounded bottom edge, framing and illumination.
No new readable text, claims, logo variants, barcodes, weights, ingredients, badges or decorative flourishes. No new vector/3D/children's-sticker mascot. Do not exaggerate contrast/saturation or add green costumes.
Image1 has a flattened cream outer backdrop only for viewing; output ONE complete package on genuine transparent alpha background, clean antialiased outline, no external shadow or halo. Output is a final packshot, not a collage, board or website.

stages.purpose: Correct raw-ball and spoon-ball texture only
stages.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is an ALMOST FINISHED package. Change ONLY TWO small food-texture regions. Image2 is a correct reference for cohesive fine-minced cooked chicken.
CRITICAL FIX A: Every visible RAW/FROZEN ball INSIDE THE PLASTIC TUB at the BOTTOM of Image1 currently has long pale rice-like strokes embedded in its surface. Remove this wrong texture completely. Give all the raw balls a COHESIVE, almost smooth, pale creamy-beige raw finely blended chicken forcemeat surface, with only a few tiny uneven pores and faint frost. The meat is ground very fine: NO visible individual meat strands, NO elongated rods, NO rice, NO streaks, NO crisscross pattern, NO oats/grain flakes, NO rough grated-cheese look, no individual pale pieces. The raw balls should look like simple homogeneous round raw chicken meatballs, similar in surface smoothness to a handmade chicken quenelle. Keep the same round ball shapes, number, arrangement, pale raw color and all packaging. Their surface must be visibly smoother and more uniform than in Image1. Do not brown the raw balls. Keep the horizontal clear PLASTIC rim/ridges completely intact — those lines belong to the tub, not to the meat.
CRITICAL FIX B: The little COOKED meatball resting in the chicken's wooden SPOON at right currently has white rice/crumbs. Replace ONLY that small ball's surface with a cohesive pale golden lightly browned surface like the WHOLE cooked chicken meatball in Image2. No rice/grainy breading. Keep its small diameter, round shape and location in the spoon.
LOCK ALL OTHER PIXELS/REGIONS from Image1: the two large photographed meatballs printed on the left, including their correct smooth fine-mince cut face; the entire illustrated chicken, every feather/eye/foot, its pose and wooden spoon; exact title/brand/subtitles/benefit text, their glyphs/size/layout/ink; cream paper; sleeve curve, brown sides, transparent tub geometry, all plastic highlights, camera, scale and framing. Do not redraw the character, do not alter the good cut surface at left, do not add anything. This is a texture correction, not a redesign.
Output the same ONE full isolated package with genuine transparent alpha surroundings and clean complete exterior, no external shadow, no background.
